reason: A requirement-management workflow plugin that organizes work through requirements, design, review, and development stages, with local CLI and document-based tracking.

summaries.zh: 用于将研发需求按需求、方案、评审和开发阶段组织管理，并通过本地命令行工具记录流程文档与评审结果。
summaries.en: A requirement-management plugin that organizes work through requirements, design, review, and development stages using a local CLI and recorded workflow documents.

capabilities: Creates and manages staged requirement workflows
Writes workflow documents and records to a configured local root directory
Invokes a local reqpipe command-line executable as a subprocess
Stores review decisions, comments, skip reasons, and stage history
